patch.summary: Streak cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Streak pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free email tools. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Streak plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free email tools
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: email sync, email tracking · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Pro
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Pro+
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: workflow automation, sales automation, reporting · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: 14-day trial · Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Streak cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Streak against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free email tools until a gated capability (contact management (Pro, Pro+, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: CRM experience is tightly coupled to Gmail/Google Workspace — poor fit for Outlook-first teams.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Gmail-centric SMB sales and founder teams requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: CRM experience is tightly coupled to Gmail/Google Workspace — poor fit for Outlook-first teams.
Side-by-side cost with Capsule on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: CRM experience is tightly coupled to Gmail/Google Workspace — poor fit for Outlook-first teams.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Automations and advanced reports are emphasized on Pro+, not base Pro.

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: AI credits are metered per user/month; additional credit packs sold separately.

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Automations and advanced reports gated to Pro+

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Streak on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model crm spend with Streak in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Streak alongside category cost modelling.
